verdict.rationale: VLP's Intellectual Property practice page has a dedicated Patents section. It states the firm prepares and files patent applications, evaluates existing portfolios, and reviews competitive technologies, which covers drafting, filing and portfolio strategy on a group page. Support rests on a single short passage, and diligence and licensing items add context without showing prosecution depth. Missing for 10: explicit prosecution detail (office actions, foreign/PCT filing), named patent practitioners, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As IP counsel, the firm offers patent prosecution and portfolio strategy — drafting and filing applications and building a defensible patent position — as a documented practice with named practitioners or group pages

citations.quote: VLP lawyers do not just prepare and file patent applications – we evaluate existing patent portfolios, review competitive technologies and intellectual property, and analyze licensing and other technology transfer issues.
